brand.name: Bitsa
brand.description:
Buy Bitsa Open-Loop Prepaid Cards on CoinGate using cryptocurrency or Visa/Mastercard. Enjoy the flexibility of modern payment methods.

 Please note, an additional fee may be imposed during the redeeming process.

products.name: Bitsa DE
products.redemption_instructions:
You can redeem your BITSA code through the website or App in a few simple steps:

Redeem online:

Go to the BITSA website and log in your BITSA Account

Select your virtual credit card

Click on Top Up, and select Voucher

Enter the code you received from Recharge.com

Accept the Terms and Conditions and top up fee

Recharge is completed.

Redeem in-app:

Open the App, click on your virtual credit card. To create a BITSA Card, click on the + in the top right corner

Click on Top Up, and select Voucher

Enter the code you received from Recharge.com

Accept the Terms and Conditions and top up fee

Recharge is completed.

To pay using the BITSA Prepaid Card, type in the credit card number and CVC wherever you want to pay with VISA. If you have a physical BITSA Card, you can use it to pay in store.

You will need to live in the European Economic Area to create a BITSA account.

Bitsa Cards expire 3 months from Creation Date
products.terms:
We are not responsible for any loss, unauthorized use, or redemption of this gift card if you share it with a third party. Please keep your gift card secure, as lost or used cards cannot be replaced.

Please note that when redeeming your prepaid gift card, some platforms may request additional actions, such as verifying your identity, completing Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures, or creating an account on their website. For more information, please refer to the specific service provider's terms and conditions

Bitsa Cards expire 3 months from creation date.

When the final user copies and pastes the voucher code in his Bitsa account, he receives the face value minus the 10% of fees.
